Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Dinesh Kumar Paliwal

On The 12 th Of July, 2024
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 27185 of 2024
 Vinod Bhatkure
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri Yashovardhan Shukla, counsel for the applicant.
 Shri Kamal Nath Nayak, P.L. for respondent/State.
 Order

This is second application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.382/2023 dated 10.11.2023 registered at Police Station - Ari, District - Seoni (M.P.) for commission of offence under Section 376, 376(2)(n), 376(2)(f), 3762)(h), 376(2)(i),
376(2)(j) and 450 of IPC and Section 92(D) of Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016.

entities.text: Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Applicant is in detention since 21.11.2023.

Applicant's first bail application was dismissed as withdrawn and not pressed vide order dated 17.02.2024 passed in M.Cr.C.No.2810/2024.
2.
As per the prosecution story, on 10.11.2023 applicant committed rape upon the prosecutrix due to which she became pregnant.
Even in pregnancy period, applicant committed rape upon her.
F.I.R was registered.
After investigation charge sheet has been filed.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant has not committed any offence.
He is innocent.
He has been falsely 2 MCRC-27185-2024 implicated.
It is submitted that D.N.A report has been received and as per D.N.A report applicant is not biological father of the child delivered by the prosecutrix.
Therefore, it is prayed that applicant may be released on bail.

4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed grant of bail but has fairly admitted that as per D.N.A report applicant is not the biological father of the child delivered by the prosecutrix.

sentences.text: 5. Having considered the submissions putforth by learned counsel for the applicant and the D.N.A report but without expressing anything on the merits of the case, I am of the view that it is a case in which further pre trial detention of the applicant is not warranted.
Consequently, this bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant - Vinod Bhatkure be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand o nly ) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
